title: From COBIT to ISO 42001: Evaluating Cybersecurity Frameworks for Opportunities, Risks, and Regulatory Compliance in Commercializing Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks have adequate provisions and human oversight controls to detect and manage culturally sensitive hallucinations, defined as LLM outputs that are culturally incoherent or diverge from mainstream human values and expectations.

Assessing the readiness of cybersecurity frameworks to manage the risks of LLMs generating discriminatory biases, real-time biases, and automated decision-making biases through qualitative content analysis and framework mapping rubrics.
